'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Garrett Larson DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3).

* '''Player:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 3
